notes.title: New NPC and new side mini quest!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings to all adventurers![/h1]

I am happy to announce the release of the first update for Tomb Nightmares.

In addition to making a bunch of minor edits, removing and adding new widgets, fixing bugs, etc.,
a new NPC has been added to the game, who is located at the very beginning of the "Test of Strength" location.

After talking to him, the NPC will show you an underground dungeon inhabited by people who once disappeared in these caves. Then there will be an opportunity to reach the "secret mini-ending". This interactive should dilute and refresh the gameplay.

P.s. I added voice acting to the NPC's lines, it turned out cringe-worthy in places, but oh well :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030934/1f7653bb7829eeecf12baf6f15a2b3bf2f934fd7.gif[/img]

Also now the game has the ability to [b]manually save[/b].

Previously, the game only had a checkpoint system that operated within the current location. I did not remove it.

I think in the future, in between working on my main projects, I'll make a full-fledged voiceover for the entire game, and add something else interesting.
Perhaps someday I'll rework the entire game, but that's not certain :D

For now, that's all.
Good luck!
